data.title: Amara Villas
data.about:
Developed by Majid Al Futtaim, Amara Twin Villas is located in Tilal Al Ghaf, a community offering resort-style living. Inspired by the graceful curves of desert dunes and lush wadis, Amara Twin Villas is perched on a stunning hilly terrain. 

The 3 to 5-bedroom villas have a covered area ranging from 1317 sq. ft. to 1916 sq. ft. Integrating nature into the living spaces, semi-outdoor areas in the stunning residences feature lush greenery, with one side overlooking the community park and the other side opening up to the public realm. 

Residents can enjoy countless activities within the community, including padel, basketball, yoga, or simply lounging by the beach. Situated at the heart of Tilal Al Ghaf, Amara provides easy access to the beach, retail shops, and dining spots that are just steps away from your doorstep.

location_tile.title: A highly sought-after community offering amazing amenities and waterfront living
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Home to white stunning beaches and a stunning Lagoon, Tilal Ghaf is a renowned community in Dubai. Indulge in a plethora of activities within a community where vibrancy seamlessly intertwines with the landscape. Immerse yourself in the dynamic atmosphere along meandering pathways, or bask in the sun's vitality at Plagette. Amara serves as the final masterpiece woven into the fabric of Tilal Al Ghaf.

  • 10 mins - City Centre Me'aisem, Dubai Production City
  • 15 mins - Mall of the Emirates, Al Barsha
  • 15 mins - Kempinski Hotel, Sheikh Zayed Road
  • 30 mins - Dubai International Airport
